summary: NORSK DYSTONIFORENING (org. no. 980 202 453) is an association (FLI) based in Drammen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-11-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 88.996 (Andre sosialtjenester uten botilbud ellers). Board chair: Marita Severinsen; auditor: PKF REVISJON AS.

No LEI is registered with GLEIF for this organisation number (common for companies without traded securities or large financial contracts).
No CEO (daglig leder) is registered; this is optional for many legal forms.
No verified Wikidata item links to this number (normal for smaller companies).
